layout.catalog.json: every node, one compact entry each - start here
layout.indexes/nodes.jsonl: one line per node (id, name, ops, desc) - grep friendly
layout.indexes/operations.jsonl: one line per operation - best file for 'which node does X'
layout.indexes/ai-tools.json: all nodes usable as AI tools
layout.tools/search.py: BM25 search CLI over the KB
layout.schema.json: JSON Schema for a node record
layout.examples/index.json: real n8n workflows bundled with the docs, as templates
layout.indexes/resources-operations.json: internal values for resource/operation/authentication options per node
